template: <div class="cc-au-card" style="{{^layout=plain}}background:#fff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:16px; padding:20px; box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(15,23,42,0.06);{{/layout=plain}}{{#layout=plain}}padding:0;{{/layout=plain}}">

{{#hasHead}}
{{^cover=}}{{/cover=}}

{{^title=}}
{{title}}
{{/title=}}{{^artist=}}
{{artist}}
{{/artist=}}
{{/hasHead}}
<audio class="cc-au-el" controls preload="none"{{^src=}} src="{{src}}"{{/src=}} style="display:block; width:100%;"></audio>
0:00
<input type="range" class="cc-au-seek" min="0" max="0" step="0.1" value="0" aria-label="Seek" style="flex:1; min-width:0; accent-color:{{accent}};">
0:00
<div class="cc-au-controls" style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:12px; margin-top:12px;">

{{#skip}}<button type="button" class="cc-au-back" aria-label="Back 15 seconds" style="min-width:44px; height:36px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; color:#0f172a; font:600 13px/1 inherit; cursor:pointer;">-15s</button>{{/skip}}

<button type="button" class="cc-au-play" aria-label="Play" style="width:52px; height:52px; padding:0; border-radius:50%; border:none; background:{{accent}}; color:#ffffff; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;"><svg class="cc-au-i-play" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="22" height="22" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg><svg class="cc-au-i-pause" style="display:none" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="22" height="22" fill="currentColor"><rect x="6" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1"/></svg></button>

{{#skip}}<button type="button" class="cc-au-fwd" aria-label="Forward 15 seconds" style="min-width:44px; height:36px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; color:#0f172a; font:600 13px/1 inherit; cursor:pointer;">+15s</button>{{/skip}}

{{#speed}}<button type="button" class="cc-au-speed" aria-label="Playback speed" style="min-width:44px; height:36px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; color:#0f172a; font:600 13px/1 inherit; cursor:pointer;">1×</button>{{/speed}}
